With a value receiver, each method gets its own copy of the Stack struct, including a copy of the items slice header. Assigning s.items inside the method changes the copy, and the copy is thrown away when the method returns.

Change Push and Pop to pointer receivers: func (s *Stack) Push(v int). Your calls don't need to change, because Go takes &s automatically when s is addressable. Make Len a pointer receiver too, for consistency.
